label: .NET performance budgets (BenchmarkDotNet)
description: The BenchmarkDotNet benchmarks of a .NET console project (in process, short job), compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: a project referencing BenchmarkDotNet; runs only where performance is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
